_about: Public-domain Arthur Cushman McGiffert (1861-1933, Union Theological Seminary church historian) for the Word Hoard: A History of Christianity in the Apostolic Age (1897), The Apostles' Creed (1902), Protestant Thought before Kant (1911), Martin Luther: the Man and his Work (1911), The Rise of Modern Religious Ideas (1915) and The God of the Early Christians (1924), from Internet Archive scans. His Eusebius is in the Schaff Fathers and not on this shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
